dedupe_keys.name: expenditure and service level data for water supply systems and sanitation facilities in ghana

description: Expenditure and service level data for water supply systems and sanitation facilities in Ghana is a data set listed in DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa), a research data metadata index, published or maintained by DANS Data Station Social Sciences and Humanities. Expenditure and services level data delivered by a variety of of water supply systems and sanitation facilities in Ghana. Primary data collection of household and water point surveys and secondary data was collected in 31 rural communities and four small towns. Service levels were developed from 1,273 household undertaken. Coverage: Ghana. The portal files it under the publisher DANS Data Station Social Sciences and Humanities. Its tags are Business and Management, Social Sciences, Life-cycle costs, Water supply, Ghana. The repository dates the deposit 2013; no later update was checked. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Zero v1.0 Universal. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water supply and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
